# Photo Library Rescue Skill for Muse

Rescue a photo library drowning in 40,000 unsorted items, screenshots, bursts, and duplicates: a backup-first triage order (verified second copy before anything is deleted), shrink passes ordered by volume-per-sentiment — screenshots first, then bursts and near-dupes, blur and pocket shots, exact duplicates last — followed by a light organizing layer (favorites plus a handful of purpose-named albums, trusting search for the rest) and a ten-minute monthly habit that keeps the cruft from growing back. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a coaching methodology, not an automated cleanup tool — the work still runs through your own platform's features.
